title: CFB Top Picks Repair Step 3 — Streamlit raw HTML renderer boundary
project: CFB Top Picks Missing Research Repair
problem: The certified V9 Python HTML contains exactly one READY/PARTIAL Market-Aware Football Reasoning selector, while the hosted Streamlit hydrated DOM omits that selector on both click and direct-detail paths.
root_cause: The visible V9 board body was sent through Streamlit Markdown hydration instead of the raw HTML rendering primitive, creating an HTML-string-to-browser-DOM divergence after server-side contracts had already passed.
patch: Keep CSS on st.markdown and render the visible V9 board body through the Streamlit placeholder raw-HTML path for both initial and loaded-detail states.
